body: It looks like these confusing conditions (only in the migration build and with client-side compilation) are not actually necessary, but instead it looks like this bug is triggered by `compilerOptions.whitespace` being set to `'preserve'` (which the migration build does, for client-side compiled templates). The text node that causes this bug is only created when `whitespace` is set to `'preserve'`, and is not created when `whitespace` is set to `'collapse'`.

issue.title: Comment inside <transition> tag breaks transition, throws warnings, in whitespace preserve mode

issue.body:
### Version 3.2.12 ### Reproduction link [codesandbox.io](https://codesandbox.io/s/vue3-compat-transition-comment-compiler-mkbte) ### Steps to reproduce 1. Load the CodeSandbox link. Note that there are several transition-related warnings in the console 2. Click the button. Note that the hidden paragraph doesn't appear, and there are two more warnings in the console. ### What is expected? No warnings should be thrown on startup. When the button is clicked, the hidden text should appear. ### What is actually happening? The hidden text does not appear. The following warnings are thrown on startup: - `Template compilation error: expects exactly one child element or component.` - ` can only be used on a single element or component. Use for lists. ` - `Extraneous non-props attributes (class) were passed to component but could not be automatically inherited because component renders fragment or text root nodes.` The latter two warnings also repeat every time the button is clicked. --- The comment itself isn't at fault: the comment gets filtered out by the transition code. However, there's also a whitespace-only text node between the comment and the `

`, and that doesn't get filtered out. So the `` tag sees that it has two children (the text node and the `

`), freaks out, and refuses to function. This is related to #4621 and #4622, which are also about whitespace-only text nodes breaking transitions (but for `` instead of ``).

issue.title: fix: fix transition-group processing of whitespace nodes

The root cause of the above issues is the same. 
**The elements inside `TransitionGroup` are comment nodes or text nodes.** We can't apply the Transition to them.
